It's the right call for a fast skyline tour, a watersports afternoon, or an add-on chase boat alongside a larger charter from the fleet. Want more deck for the same group? The 28' Axopar Brabus and 46' Maxum are the next steps up.

$1,000 for a 4-hour private charter, licensed captain included. Get an exact quote for your date by phone or WhatsApp.
What is the Yamaha 255XD best for?
Fast, agile fun: skyline runs, sandbar days and watersports sessions for smaller groups who'd rather be on the water than lounging on a big deck.

axopar-brabus.intro_html:
The 28' Axopar Brabus Edition is the sport boat of the fleet — a 28-foot Axopar finished by Brabus, built for performance and style. It charters with a licensed captain and crew for $1,200 for 4 hours.

This isn't a lounge-and-drift yacht. It's a fast, sharp-handling day boat with bold Brabus design, made for running the bay, hopping between spots and getting to the sandbar before everyone else. It's the pick for small groups, couples and anyone who'd take a supercar over a limo.

For a similar fast-boat day at $1,000, see the 25' Yamaha 255XD; for a proper yacht deck, the 48' Isabella comes with a jet ski at $1,499. Charters depart 668 NW N River Dr on the Miami River and run Biscayne Bay, Star Island, Fisher Island and Nixon's Sandbar. See the whole fleet or compare prices.
axopar-brabus.onboard_html:
The Axopar is a walkaround sport boat: you move from bow to stern along either side without climbing over anything. The helm sits under a T-top with rows of diamond-stitched navy seats behind it, and the aft deck is open for sun and for getting in and out of the water.

Twin outboards on the transom make it one of the fastest rides in the fleet, so more of your four hours go to the stop itself.

Fast skyline runs, sandbar days and small groups who want a high-performance sport boat with Brabus styling.
What is on board the Axopar?
A T-top helm, rows of diamond-stitched seats, walkaround side decks, an open aft deck and twin outboard engines.

From our dock at 668 NW N River Dr on the Miami River, about 10 minutes from Brickell and 15 minutes from Miami Beach. From there you cruise down the river into Biscayne Bay.

isabella.intro_html:
The 48' Isabella is the yacht in our fleet that comes with a jet ski included in the charter. For $1,499 you get a 48-foot motor yacht, a licensed captain and crew, and a jet ski to take turns on once the anchor is down.

That combination makes it the most fun-per-dollar boat we run. Cruise out past the skyline, drop anchor in Biscayne Bay, and half the group is on the water while the other half is on deck. It's the yacht we point people to for birthdays, bachelor and bachelorette days, and any group that gets restless just sitting still.

Charters leave from 668 NW N River Dr on the Miami River, about 10 minutes from Brickell. anvera.intro_html:
The 62' Anvera is the yacht for people who care how a boat moves. It's a 62-foot high-performance Italian yacht — low, sleek and fast — chartered with a licensed captain and crew from $1,700 for 4 hours.

Where most yachts this size are built like floating apartments, the Anvera is built like a sports car: clean open deck, sharp lines, and a ride that makes the run across Biscayne Bay part of the day rather than the commute. It photographs better than anything near its price, which is why it's a favorite for content shoots, couples and sunset charters.

Departures are from our Miami River dock, 10 minutes from Brickell and 15 from Miami Beach. Want a more classic yacht layout at a similar rate? Look at the 55' Azimut. Want more length? The 65' Azimut L'chaim and 75' Ferretti are both $3,000. The Anvera is also our top pick for a private sunset cruise.
anvera.onboard_html:
The Anvera is built around one long open deck. At the stern are three wide sun loungers and terraces that fold down to open the deck out over the water. Midship, a dining table and bench seating sit in the shade of the hardtop, with speakers built into the seating.

Forward of the helm, a sunpad covers the bow. Below deck is a bright white cabin with a wraparound lounge and a sofa: a place to get out of the sun without leaving the party.

azimut-lchaim.intro_html:
L'chaim means “to life” — a toast — and this 65-foot Azimut is chartered exactly that way. It's a full-size Italian motor yacht with a licensed captain and crew, from $3,000 for 4 hours.

At 65 feet you're in proper big-yacht territory: the kind of boat that turns heads coming down the Miami River and holds its own anchored off Star Island. It's the yacht we recommend when the occasion matters — a milestone birthday, an engagement, a bachelorette weekend's main event, or a client day that has to land.

It sits between the 62' Anvera at $1,700 and the 90-foot Deep Blue at $4,999, and shares its rate with the 75' Ferretti. Charters depart 668 NW N River Dr and cruise Biscayne Bay, Star Island and Fisher Island, with Stiltsville and Nixon's Sandbar in reach on longer bookings. Planning the party? See yacht parties and birthday charters.
azimut-lchaim.onboard_html:
The L'chaim gives a group three places to be at once. The flybridge has its own helm, a lounge with a table and a sunpad under the bimini. The aft deck has a teak dining table in the shade, and the bow has a wide sunpad.

Inside, the salon is finished in tan leather and cherry wood, with a galley alongside. Below are a master cabin, a VIP cabin, a twin cabin and bathrooms with showers. The inflatable slide and water toys shown in the gallery are available at an additional cost.

From our dock at 668 NW N River Dr on the Miami River, about 10 minutes from Brickell and 15 minutes from Miami Beach. From there you cruise down the river into Biscayne Bay.

deep-blue.onboard_html:
You board onto a wide teak aft deck with a full-width sofa and stairs up to the flybridge. Glass doors open into the main salon: two cream sofas, glossy wood finishes and long windows down both sides.

Forward of the salon, a formal dining table sits next to a galley with a stone-topped island and a full-size refrigerator, and beyond that is the helm with its twin captain's chairs. Below deck are a master cabin with a double bed, twin-bed guest cabins and bathrooms. The Jacuzzi is what sets Deep Blue apart from every other yacht in the fleet.

Large celebrations, corporate events and once-only occasions. It's a 90-foot superyacht with an onboard Jacuzzi.
What is on board Deep Blue?
A Jacuzzi, a teak aft deck with a full-width sofa, a flybridge, a main salon with two sofas, a formal dining table, a full galley, and cabins and bathrooms below deck.
Where does the 90' Deep Blue depart from?
From our dock at 668 NW N River Dr on the Miami River, about 10 minutes from Brickell and 15 minutes from Miami Beach. From there you cruise down the river into Biscayne Bay.
